name: Websites - Authorized - Cloud Storage & Documents Domains [is]
description: Intent: Authorized cloud storage and document-collaboration domains — populate with sanctioned cloud platforms (e.g., box.com, dropbox.com, drive.google.com, sharepoint.com, onedrive.live.com). Drives the Authorized split on D1020 / M1020 (Internal cloud storage / docs) and is negated to define the Unauthorized surface on D1021 / M1021 / W1021 / B1020. Top priority to populate — second-most-used segmentation list in the v0 system. Exclusions: do not add personal-tier domains unless your org has corporate licensing; do not add file-sync services without security review.
